tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: FREE. Returns every dataset for sale: id, title, category (crypto/DeFi token prices, volume, TVL and yields; e-commerce product prices and stock; custom scraped feeds), row count, field names, created_at (freshness), a few sample rows and the price in USDC (starter sets from $0.01, up to 100 rows $0

tools.name: preview_dataset
tools.description: FREE. Sample of a dataset before buying: up to 10 real rows from the dataset (never more than half of it), all field names, total row count, created_at timestamp and the exact USDC price buy_dataset will charge. JSON output.

tools.name: scrape_url
tools.description: PAID, $0.001-$0.025 USDC. Any web page as clean, LLM-ready Markdown (boilerplate stripped) for your agent's context, e.g. url=https://example.com. Fetches the URL live (typically 1-5 s; stealth tier longer) and returns clean Markdown, JSON-LD, HTML tables and links as JSON. Tiers: cached_intel $0.00

tools.name: buy_dataset
tools.description: PAID, $0.01-$4.99 USDC by size (shown in list_datasets). Every row of a dataset in one download, e.g. dataset_id=live_crypto_top500_markets (500 coins). Formats: json, jsonl, csv or markdown. Live feeds refresh about every 30 min. An unpaid call returns the exact x402 price.

tools.name: free_feeds
tools.description: FREE. Catalog of every live feed, refreshed about every 30 min (crypto, DeFi, Polymarket, stocks, new pools, token risk) with row counts, freshness and full price, plus the paid single-lookup tools and their prices.

tools.name: free_crypto_top10
tools.description: FREE. Top 10 crypto prices: rank, USD price, market cap and 24h change for the 10 largest coins (snapshot refreshed about every 30 min). lookup_coin ($0.001) covers 500 coins with more fields.

tools.name: free_defi_top_yields
tools.description: FREE. Top 5 DeFi yields across all chains ranked by risk-adjusted APY, with APY, TVL and risk level. lookup_yields ($0.002) filters by chain/token.

tools.name: free_regime
tools.description: FREE. Risk-on / risk-off regime label and 0-100 score, delayed at least 1 hour. regime_now ($0.02) gives the live score, why, drivers and components.

tools.name: free_ecom
tools.description: FREE. Stats for the e-commerce index of ~500 Shopify brand stores (stores, products, variants by category), last crawl time, sample price drops (delayed 24h) and deepest discounts on sale now. ecom_product ($0.01) looks up any product's live price and stock.

tools.name: free_staking_yields
tools.description: FREE. Top 3 liquid-staking and yield-bearing stablecoin APYs (stETH, rETH, sUSDe...) from on-chain exchange-rate changes. staking_yields ($0.005) returns all 8 with TVL and exchange rates.

tools.name: free_funding
tools.description: FREE. Hyperliquid funding rate for BTC, ETH and SOL, delayed 15 min. perp_funding ($0.01) gives every coin live.

tools.name: staking_yields
tools.description: PAID $0.005 USDC. APY (7-day on-chain exchange-rate change), TVL and exchange rate for stETH, rETH, cbETH, weETH, sfrxETH, sUSDe, sUSDS and sDAI. Optional token filter.

tools.name: pendle_fixed
tools.description: PAID $0.01 USDC. Implied fixed APY, expiry, days left and PT price for every active Pendle market on Ethereum, Arbitrum and Base, read on-chain. Filter by chain, q (symbol search), min_days.

tools.name: perp_funding
tools.description: PAID $0.01 USDC. Live Hyperliquid funding (1h, 8h, APR), direction, premium, mark/oracle price, open interest and 24h volume. Optional coin filter and limit.

tools.name: ecom_product
tools.description: PAID $0.01 USDC. Search ~500 Shopify brand stores by product name or SKU: current price, compare-at price, discount %, in-stock flag, URL, image and a daily 30-day price/stock history. Optional domain filter. No match returns an error with no charge.

tools.name: ecom_changes
tools.description: PAID $0.02 USDC. Price drops, price rises, restocks, sell-outs, new products and removals detected between daily crawls of ~500 Shopify stores. Filter by type (comma list), domain, category, brand, days (1-30), limit.

tools.name: ecom_snapshot
tools.description: PAID $0.05 USDC. For a store domain, brand or category: product and variant counts, in-stock %, avg/median/min/max price, share on sale, top product types and brands, deepest live discounts, newest products, 7-day change counts.

tools.name: ecom_catalog
tools.description: PAID $0.25 USDC. Every current product variant of one Shopify store in the index with price, compare-at price, stock flag, SKU, tags, URL and image. Store list is free at /v1/free/ecom/stores.

tools.name: lookup_coin
tools.description: PAID $0.001 USDC. Current BTC, ETH or any top-500 coin price: USD price, market cap, volume, 1h/24h/7d change and % below all-time high. Examples: q=btc, q=ethereum. Refreshed about every 30 min, answers in under 100 ms. Unknown coin returns an error with no charge.

tools.name: lookup_protocol
tools.description: PAID $0.001 USDC. DeFi protocol TVL in USD, 1d/7d TVL change, category, chains and market cap. Examples: q=aave, q=uniswap. Refreshed about every 30 min.

tools.name: lookup_yields
tools.description: PAID $0.002 USDC. Best USDC yield on Base (or any chain/token): top 10 pools ranked by risk-adjusted APY with APY, TVL and 0-100 risk score. Example: chain=Base, token=USDC. Takes chain, token or both. Refreshed about every 30 min.

tools.name: lookup_pool
tools.description: PAID $0.001 USDC. One on-chain DeFi lending pool (Aave v3/Compound v3/Moonwell/Morpho Blue) by pool id protocol:chain:token_address, e.g. aave-v3:base:0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913: supply/borrow APY, utilization, TVL, impermanent-loss risk and risk score. Refreshed about every 30 min.

tools.name: lookup_polymarket
tools.description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Polymarket odds for an event: up to 10 markets matching a keyword with YES probability, 1h/24h/7d odds change, volume and liquidity. Examples: q=bitcoin, q=election. Refreshed about every 30 min.

tools.name: lookup_token_risk
tools.description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Base token scam check: verdict go / caution / avoid, honeypot / cannot-sell, hidden owner, mintable, buy/sell tax and a 0-100 risk score. No charge if the scan fails. Example: address=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913. Cached scan, else live GoPlus (about 1-3 s).

tools.name: free_datasets
tools.description: FREE. Catalog of the paid dataset listings (CoinGecko market tables, DefiLlama tables, live volume leaders, live DeFi heatmap, live DEX volume) with price, row count and last update time.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: PAID $0.002 USDC per call. Rows from one dataset listing: coingecko-markets (about 7,000 market table rows), defillama-protocols, live volume-leaders, live market-heatmap, live dex-volume. Optional q keyword filter, limit (1-1000), offset, format json or csv.

tools.name: market_pulse
tools.description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Whole crypto market in one call: top 10 coins by market cap, top volume leaders, top DeFi protocols by TVL, DEX volume leaders and total, and DeFi heatmap highlights (biggest sectors, 1d gainers and losers). No parameters. No charge if sources are unavailable.

tools.name: price_moves
tools.description: PAID $0.002 USDC. Coins (top 500) whose price moved more than threshold % (default 5) over 1h and/or 24h, biggest first, plus DeFi protocols whose TVL moved more than threshold in 1d. Built for polling. Empty list is a valid answer.

tools.name: defi_intel
tools.description: PAID $0.003 USDC. One call: top 10 DeFi protocols by TVL, 1d TVL gainers/losers, top chains by TVL, top stablecoins with supply change, top 10 risk-ranked yields. No parameters.

tools.name: ad_cost_benchmarks
tools.description: PAID $0.002 USDC. CPM, CPC, CTR by ad platform (meta, google_search, google_display, tiktok, linkedin) and industry, each figure with source report, URL and as-of date. Optional platform, industry, metric.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: PAID $0.001 USDC. Cheapest paid call to confirm your x402 payment works: returns ok, server time and catalog links. No parameters.

tools.name: whale_moves
tools.description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Large taker orders (default >= $100k) on Hyperliquid perps (top 40 markets) in the last window with side, USD size, price, taker address, plus net whale buy/sell per coin. Built for polling.

tools.name: whale_netflow
tools.description: PAID $0.02 USDC. Whale transfers (>= $100k) on ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon, solana classified by exchange wallet labels: EXCHANGE_INFLOW_BEARISH, WHALE_ACCUMULATION_BULLISH, INTERNAL_EXCHANGE_SHUFFLE, UNLABELED, with per-token inflow/outflow/net USD and signal, plus Hyperliquid whale perp take

tools.name: whale_token
tools.description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Whale orders and net whale buy/sell for one Hyperliquid coin (e.g. BTC, SOL, HYPE) plus mark price, 24h change, funding and open interest.

tools.name: token_verdict
tools.description: PAID $0.005 USDC. go / caution / avoid verdict, 0-100 risk score and the facts behind it (liquidity, holders, top-10 concentration, LP locked, taxes, honeypot, mint/proxy/owner flags) for a token on base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche or solana. No charge if the scan fails.

tools.name: wallet_profile
tools.description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Who is this wallet: label exchange / whale / active_trader / fresh_wallet / dormant, 0-100 activity score with reasons, native + USDC balance, tx count, first/last activity, exchange label and whale transfer history. Chains ethereum, base, solana. Computed from raw chain RPC.

tools.name: regime_now
tools.description: PAID $0.02 USDC. Is the market risk-on or risk-off right now, and why: 0-100 composite score, regime label, confidence, macro vs crypto sub-scores, macro quadrant, Fed liquidity trend, plain-English why, top drivers, 9 component scores (Fed liquidity, rates/curve, growth/inflation, financial conditi

tools.name: regime_full
tools.description: PAID $0.05 USDC. Everything in regime_now plus raw metrics for every component, 30-day score history, 7-day trend and full methodology (weights, thresholds, sources). No parameters.

tools.name: dd_report
tools.description: PAID $1.00 USDC. Full due-diligence report on a token or wallet: executive verdict, red and green flags, DEX liquidity, holder concentration, 7-day whale moves/netflow, lending listings, counterparty check, recommendation (allow/caution/avoid) with confidence, data timestamps and explorer proof link

tools.name: dd_quick
tools.description: PAID $0.25 USDC. Quick due-diligence on a token or wallet: allow/caution/avoid with confidence, trust score, top 3 red flags, DEX liquidity and holder concentration. Chains base, ethereum, solana. No charge on failure.

tools.name: trust_agent
tools.description: PAID $0.04 USDC. One call before you pay, trade with or let through an outside agent, wallet or token: allow / caution / block, a 0-100 trust score and plain-English reasons. Combines Counterparty Check, wallet profile and (for tokens) the token security verdict. Chains base, ethereum, solana. No ch

tools.name: counterparty_check
tools.description: PAID $0.02 USDC. Before paying or trading: send one wallet or token and get safe / caution / block, a 0-100 safety score and reasons. Auto-detects token vs wallet; combines token contract checks (impostor symbol, owner, proxy, Solana mint/freeze authority), holder concentration, wallet profile, whal

tools.name: token_holders
tools.description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Solana token holder concentration: top-10 share of supply, largest holder share, exchange-labelled holders and a low / medium / high verdict with reasons. Pass the mint as address.

tools.name: scrape_text
tools.description: PAID $0.003 USDC. Any web page as clean, LLM-ready Markdown text with navigation, ads and boilerplate stripped: title, text and character count. Example: url=https://example.com. No charge if the page cannot be fetched.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_datasets, scrape_url, ecom_product, ecom_catalog, scrape_text · Private data: list_datasets, free_feeds, free_defi_top_yields, staking_yields, lookup_yields, lookup_token_risk, whale_netflow, whale_token, token_verdict, wallet_profile, dd_report, dd_quick, trust_agent, counterparty_check, token_holders · Public sink: ecom_snapshot, counterparty_check, token_holders · Destructive: get_dataset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_datasets, scrape_url, ecom_product, ecom_catalog, scrape_text · Private data: list_datasets, free_feeds, free_defi_top_yields, staking_yields, lookup_yields, lookup_token_risk, whale_netflow, whale_token, token_verdict, wallet_profile, dd_report, dd_quick, trust_agent, counterparty_check, token_holders · Public sink: ecom_snapshot, counterparty_check, token_holders · Destructive: get_dataset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
